dataIdInfo.idPurp: Sites on the Qhapac Ñan, modern cities, Inka sites, Sites buried by cities.
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
The position of each point was taken from Google maps . In most cases is located over the archaeological site, or de center of the main plaza . Points showing sites on the Qhapac Ñan, some sites are Inka sites, some sites are buried under modern cities, and some are modern cities. Based on: (Chacaltana, Arkush, and Marcone 2011, 15. Fig. 1)
